text: Implemented portable DCT-II temporal basis support and TemporalBasisEncoder DCT/provided-basis entry points. Added fixture-backed DctBasisSuite coverage for fmrilatent R constants, orthonormal Gram law, full-rank ortho/raw roundtrips, centered offsets, and invalid component validation. Verified: sbt latentJVM/test latentJS/test passed 13 tests on each platform; Rscript tools/r-parity/fmrilatent-dct-fixtures.R runs and prints fixtures.
